correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and boundary cases are explicit. Fibonacci completion ratios yield the Markov limit; after a 1 the geometric zero gaps are independent. Equal-mass permutation patterns with unique sentinel are mutually nonoverlapping, so their earliest occurrence is uniform; the event is FO-definable for fixed parameters and terminates almost surely. The two rational conditional acceptance rates tend to any target quadratic-field element and exactly mix to it. The upper bound uses the aperiodic syntactic monoid to prove full-entropy product components are closed and primitive, giving a convergent phi^n leading count with residue in Q(phi). The standard-library checker verified independent finite consequences and exact quadratic-field mixing; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The golden-mean language is the simplest nontrivial mixing finite-type binary constraint; its exact FO limiting-probability invariant is a natural missing refinement beyond mere convergence/density. The theorem identifies the entire attainable quadratic field, including irrational probabilities, and gives an explicit renewal-selector construction that separates conditional Markov words from unrestricted fair words. This is a complete structural classification of a motivated logical invariant, not an arbitrary finite census.
